inspection_scope: Official arXiv abstracts; no full-paper theorem audit in this pass. Local physical controls and mathematical bounds are separate review-pending derivations.

sources.title: Quantum Amplitude Amplification and Estimation
sources.mechanism: Amplify a preparation's success using that preparation and its inverse; account for success uncertainty.
sources.local_use: Cost and actually execute A/A inverse rather than granting a reflection about an unknown coset state.
sources.not_transferred: Calibration success does not certify an efficient preparation, unknown-success schedule or total-runtime advantage.

sources.title: Tight bounds on quantum searching
sources.mechanism: Unstructured quantum search and unknown solution counts.
sources.local_use: Comparator for the clean equality-marker-only interface.
sources.not_transferred: No Grover lower bound is asserted against all full-function DHSP algorithms.

sources.title: A subexponential-time quantum algorithm for the dihedral hidden subgroup problem
sources.mechanism: Combining phase/representation information to decode a hidden dihedral subgroup.
sources.local_use: Established subexponential comparator; small collision probabilities or birthday-level performance are not a breakthrough.
sources.not_transferred: No best-current constants or exhaustive literature comparison is claimed.

sources.title: Search via Quantum Walk
sources.mechanism: Costed walk-based search with approximate reflections and amplification.
sources.local_use: Reminder to verify preparation, inverse, marking and reflection interfaces.
sources.not_transferred: This Floquet collision protocol has not been shown to satisfy the MNRS framework or its stationary/gap assumptions.

sources.title: Three-state quantum walk on the Cayley graph of the dihedral group
sources.mechanism: Position-distribution and localization properties of a different dihedral-group walk.
sources.local_use: Countercheck against conflating group-walk localization with hidden-subgroup decoding.
sources.not_transferred: Neither a DHSP oracle recovery algorithm nor a theorem about the present Fourier driver is established by this source.
